name: template_only_class_constant
template:
class Greeter
  DEFAULT_GREETING = "Hello"

  def greet(name)
    "#{DEFAULT_GREETING} #{name}"
  end
end
destination:
class Greeter
  def greet(name)
    name.upcase
  end
end

expected.output:
class Greeter
  DEFAULT_GREETING = "Hello"

  def greet(name)
    name.upcase
  end
end
